summary: Learn to define DEI metrics, analyse workforce data, and govern reporting. Explore the five-day course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Data-driven DEI measurement helps HR analysts, DEI leads, people-analytics specialists, and managers define and report workforce inclusion indicators. You’ll create consistent metrics, check data quality, and analyse representation and disaggregated results while applying safeguards for small groups and sensitive information. Exercises also cover dashboard design, interpreting findings, and linking them to accountable actions, using GRI 405 and GRI 406 as reporting references.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who define, analyse, govern, or act on diversity, equity, and inclusion data in workforce and service settings. It suits intermediate learners who work with people information or contribute to DEI measurement and reporting.
modules: Privacy Risk and Data Quality Controls
prerequisites: Intermediate level. Prior work with workforce, people, or programme data is recommended, along with basic spreadsheet skills. No coding or programming is required for course completion.
